description: This file implements MD5-HMAC cryptographic functions for the Linux kernel, including key setting, transformation, update, and final hash computation, specifically for the DEU module in the Infineon UEIP project.

methods.name: endian_swap
methods.description: Performs a 32-bit endian swap on the input value.

methods.name: md5_hmac_transform
methods.description: Saves input block to the MD5-HMAC context, with a workaround for database size.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets the HMAC key in the context, supporting keys up to 64 bytes.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Loads the HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: md5_hmac_init
methods.description: Initializes the MD5-HMAC context and hardware.

methods.name: md5_hmac_update
methods.description: Performs on-the-fly MD5-HMAC computation with input data.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final
methods.description: Computes the final MD5-HMAC value and resets the context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5_hmac
methods.description: Registers the MD5-HMAC driver with the Linux crypto API.
